p: Being inside the shopping centre makes this the easy one to drop into between errands, and it works best treated that way: a short stop during the day rather than a night out. It's an adult gaming centre, so 18+ only.

Hartlepool station is just a few minutes from Middleton Grange, which makes the centre a handy base if you've come in by train. Once the shopping's done, the Headland is worth the trip out. It's the old part of town on the point, with St Hilda's Church, the Heugh Battery Museum (a coastal gun battery that fired back during the 1914 bombardment) and a breezy promenade. Grab a bag of chips and walk it off along the sea wall.
